title: The Power of Antigravity in Modern Web Development

children.text: Welcome to the new Power Marketing International blog! This is a sample post demonstrating our new headless CMS architecture powered by Sanity and Astro. We are using a premium design to showcase expertise.

faqs.question: Why use Astro with Sanity?
faqs.answer: Astro delivers zero-JS static sites by default, resulting in perfect Lighthouse scores, while Sanity provides a deeply customizable headless CMS for dynamic content.
